It is a clear morning, about 15.4°C, under a cloudless sky.

scenes.description: From the south quay the view looks along the Ha'penny Bridge, a single white cast-iron arch with a humped deck and lamp standards on the railings. The Liffey runs under the arch, and Georgian brick houses line the quays. It is one bridge, not the stone arches of O'Connell Bridge and not the later harp-shaped bridge downstream. It is a clear morning, about 15.4°C, under a cloudless sky.
